lines.text: GO Pass: October
From Tuesday, October 6, at 10:00 a.m. to Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time, the GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for October will be available in Pokémon GO!
GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: October on Tuesday, October 6, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time.
Additionally, from Saturday, October 31, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 1, at 11:59 p.m. local time , there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!
For US$7.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.
For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.
Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, November 5, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!
Pokémon GO Web Store

The GO Pass Deluxe, the paid version of the GO Pass, will also be available on the Pokémon GO Web Store ! Your GO Pass Deluxe purchased via the Pokémon GO Web Store will activate as soon as the GO Pass begins.
Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: October on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, one Premium Battle Pass, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: October + 10 Ranks on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, two Premium Battle Passes, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Or stock up on the essentials alongside your upgrade with the web-exclusive GO Pass Deluxe: October Ultra Box which includes 20 Ultra Balls, 10 Max Revives, five Premium Battle Passes, and 10 Max Potions as a gift with purchase!
Featured Pokémon and Rewards
Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following rewards.
Encounter with Kyogre*
Rare Candy XL
Premium Battle Pass
Lucky Egg
And even more goodies!
Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.
A Lucky Trinket
One Super Incubator
Additional encounters with even more Pokémon!
And even more goodies!

Major Milestone Bonuses
Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses.
Tier 1 Bonus Starting at Rank 1
One additional Candy for trading Pokémon.
Trainers level 31 and above will receive one guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon.
Tier 2 Bonus Starting at Rank 25
Open up to 40 Gifts per day.
Receive up to 125 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStops and Gym Photo Discs.
Hold 10 more Gifts in your Item Bag.
Tier 3 Bonus Starting at Rank 50
2× Daily Adventure Incense duration.
Tier 4 Bonus Starting at Rank 75
Increased Stardust and XP from hatching Eggs.
Upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe to strengthen the following bonus.
Tier 2 Bonus Starting at Rank 25
Open up to 50 Gifts per day.
Receive up to 150 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStops and Gym Photo Discs.
Hold up to 20 more Gifts in your Item Bag.
The Lucky Trinket
The Lucky Trinket will return as the final reward in this month’s GO Pass Deluxe.

A Lucky Trinket is a one-time-use item that can be used to turn one friend from your Friend List into a Lucky Friend. When used, the Lucky Trinket will set the status of you and your chosen friend to Lucky, even if you aren’t Best Friends yet!
When you’re Lucky Friends with someone, the next time you trade with each other, both Pokémon will become Lucky Pokémon. After the trade, your Lucky Friend status will be cleared.

This exciting item will only stay in your Item Bag for a limited time, so don’t forget to use it! The Lucky Trinket earned as a part of GO Pass: October will expire on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time, regardless of when you claimed it.

You must be at least Great Friends with the Trainer you wish to apply your Lucky Trinket to. You cannot use a Lucky Trinket with a Trainer you are currently Lucky Friends with. Using a Lucky Trinket on a friend does not change the distance at which you can complete a trade. If you do not want to allow other Trainers to use their Lucky Trinkets on you, you can disable this permission in your Settings page.

Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.
—The Pokémon GO team

GO Pass

Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks or the various accomplishments listed here. Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.
Trainers will also have access to Weekly Tasks to earn points and increase their rank. The Weekly Tasks are as follows:
Catch 75 Pokémon - 200 PTS
Win a raid - 150 PTS
Make 20 Great Throws - 150 PTS
Hatch 3 Eggs - 150 PTS
Spin 25 PokéStops or Gyms - 100 PTS
Use 20 Berries to help catch Pokémon - 100 PTS
Earn 10 hearts with your buddy - 150 PTS
There is also a daily task:
GO Pass: October Daily
Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS
GO Pass Deluxe: October Daily
Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS
Trainers can earn up to 250 extra points daily by completing certain tasks.
Win a raid - 100 PTS
Hatch an Egg - 40 PTS
Catch a Pokémon - 5 PTS
